name: Ideogram 4.0
notes: API-first; no open weights released yet. Tier 3 — monitor for open-weight drop.

name: Z-Image Turbo
notes: SDXL-distilled 4-step. Custom sampler mapping needed. Fits 16 GB with SDXL tiling.

name: FLUX.2 Dev (32B)
notes: 32 B params. FP8 still needs ~18-24 GB VRAM — exceeds RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB budget. Monitor for GGUF Q4 drop.

name: Microsoft Lens Turbo
notes: MIT licence, ~11 GB FP16. Works with ComfyUI v0.23.0 UNETLoader. Drop-in for txt2img 4-step turbo.

name: NVIDIA PixelDiT 1300M
notes: 1.3 B pixel-space DiT. 4-6 GB VRAM. ComfyUI node via comfyui-pixeldit (v0.23.0). Research model — quality unclear vs SDXL.

name: Qwen Image Edit 2.0
notes: GGUF Q4 ~13 GB. #1 on AI Arena (Feb 2026). Qwen2-VL backbone — fits within Klein CLIP infrastructure already present.

name: FLUX.1-dev ControlNet Inpainting Beta
notes: SealesEmpire release June 14 2026. FLUX.1-dev ControlNet for inpainting. Needs inpaint-specific ControlNet node wiring.

name: PIXLRelight
notes: PBR-based relighting (May 18 paper). No ComfyUI node yet. High implementation risk — monitor for node drop.

name: Wan 2.7
notes: 14 B successor to Wan 2.2. Native ComfyUI support via existing Wan nodes. Needs VRAM headroom test — may require sequential offload.

name: Bernini-R (Wan 2.2 fine-tune)
notes: Drop-in Wan 2.2 UNET replacement. Motion-realism fine-tune. Same node graph as build_wan22_t2v.

name: SCAIL-2
notes: Spatially-consistent animation via Wan latent guidance. Requires new LatentGuidance node. Medium integration effort.

name: LTX-Video 2.3 distilled
notes: Distilled 4-step variant. Needs sampler config update in build_ltx_video. ComfyUI node updated in v0.23.0.

name: HunyuanVideo 1.5
notes: Drop-in checkpoint update for build_hunyuan_video. Improved temporal consistency. ~13 GB FP8 — fits 16 GB.

name: Helios 14B (FramePack successor)
notes: 14 B model. VRAM budget tight even with FP8. Requires new node graph for extended-frame scheduling.

name: FlashVSR v1.1
notes: 2x faster than v1.0 with same PSNR. Drop-in checkpoint swap in build_video_upscale.

name: SwiftVR
notes: ByteDance diffusion-based video restoration. Faster than SeedVR2. New ComfyUI node needed — not yet in node registry.

name: SeedVR2 v2.5
notes: Improved tiling + artifact suppression. API-compatible with v2.0. Needs checkpoint update and tile-size config check.

name: CogVideoX GGUF + FasterCache
notes: GGUF Q4 quantisation now in kijai's wrapper; FasterCache node halves inference time. Drop-in node graph update.

name: DreamID-V (video face-swap)
notes: Temporal-consistent video face-swap. No ComfyUI node yet. Medium implementation risk.

name: ReActor + GPEN 1024 restore
notes: ReActor node now bundles GPEN-1024 for post-swap restoration. Drop-in node update — improves quality on sub-512 faces.

name: BFS Head V5 LoRA
notes: Klein-compatible headswap LoRA. V5 adds occluded-ear handling. Swap LoRA path in build_klein_headswap; needs identity-blend weight tuning.

name: SwapAnyHead (paper)
notes: Research paper only; no weights released. Tier 3 — low confidence, monitor for release.

name: PMRF (Posterior Mean Regularized Flow)
notes: Flow-matching face restoration. SOTA on blind face restore benchmarks. ComfyUI node via comfyui-pmrf (v0.23.0). Additive — new restore option alongside CodeFormer.

name: facerestore_advanced node
notes: Unified restore node supporting CodeFormer, GFPGAN, RestoreFormer, PMRF. Drop-in replacement for current restore call with selector param.

name: SAM 3.1 Multiplex
notes: SAM 3.1 supports multi-object prompt batching (multiplex). Drop-in via comfyui-sam3 node update. Improves throughput for multi-subject scenes.

name: SAM 3.1 Multiplex
notes: Same SAM 3.1 upgrade applies to build_sam3_mask — multiplex mask batching.

name: SAM 3.1 Multiplex
notes: Same SAM 3.1 upgrade applies to build_sam3_extract — multiplex extract batching.

name: DA3 native ComfyUI node
notes: build_depth_map_v3 already targets da3_large.safetensors. New native ComfyUI node removes the controlnet_preprocessor shim — cleaner pipeline, same output.

name: BiRefNet lite-matting + dynamic resolution
notes: Lite variant halves VRAM. Dynamic-resolution inference improves portrait edges. Drop-in checkpoint swap.

name: BEN2 + FOCUS via RMBG v3
notes: BEN2 background eraser + FOCUS hair-detail refiner now bundled in RMBG v3 node. Drop-in update.

name: MoGe-2
notes: Monocular geometry estimation v2. Better normals on non-Lambertian surfaces. ComfyUI node available (comfyui-moge). Additive — add as alternative backend.

name: Sapiens2 Normal 1B
notes: Human-body-specific normal map at 1 B params. Excellent for portrait/figure shots. Custom loader needed — not yet in ComfyUI node registry.

name: Hunyuan3D 2.5
notes: Improved mesh topology + multi-view consistency. ComfyUI node updated. Needs VRAM test (was tight at 2.0).

name: Hunyuan3D 2.1 (texture update)
notes: Texture-quality patch release. Drop-in checkpoint swap for build_hunyuan_3d_textured. Reduces texture seams on curved surfaces.

name: ComfyUI-PuLID-Flux2
notes: PuLID port for FLUX.2 Klein. Early release — API may shift. Relevant to Whimweaver replay-value bridge (see WHIMWEAVER_REPLAY_BRIDGE_PROPOSAL.md).

name: SD4 ControlNet (community)
notes: Community ControlNet adapters for SD4 (June 2026). SD4 architecture not yet in spellcaster — would require new build_sd4_* methods. Monitor.
